findings.summary: tweet author is quoted but not YAML-escaped, unlike every other field the diff fixes.
findings.mechanism: `author: "{tweet_author}"` interpolates `data.get("author_name")` directly into a double-quoted YAML scalar without calling `_yaml_str()`. If the fetched author name contains a `"` or backslash, it breaks out of the quoted string and can inject arbitrary YAML frontmatter keys — the exact vulnerability class this commit was written to close, left open on this one field.
